The '''Taris sector''' was a small subsector of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] that contained the [[Taris system/Legends|Taris system]].

==History==
The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Haydel Goravvus]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. After the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] conquest of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the whole sector was annexed by the Sith Fleet under [[Darth Malak]]. Later, an amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] became the Taris sector [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|racing]] champion in [[3956 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' first mentioned the Taris sector, but later sources placed the Taris system in the Ojoster sector. The [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] resolved the discrepancy by specifying that the Taris sector was a subsector of the Ojoster sector.
